overview.text: His campaign says the department reported a 14% decline in homicides and increased crime clearance rates during his first term. His campaign also says he established the Office of Constitutional Policing and banned deputy gangs. A county oversight body documented a 16% reduction in custody use of force and an 11% reduction in patrol use of force. It also noted a 42% drop in shooting-involved deaths. He is planning a Correctional Care Center for inmates, over half of whom have mental health or substance use issues. The department is replacing its decades-old computer dispatch system and deploying drones and license plate readers.
